about_the_game:
Command vast armies of samurai in large-scale tactical battles. Every soldier is individually simulated — watch as thousands of warriors clash, react, and fight with a life of their own. Outsmart your opponent with superior tactics, or overwhelm them with sheer force.

Deep Simulation

Battle Match models every aspect of the battlefield:
  • Physics: Ballistics, armor penetration, terrain elevation, vegetation cover, and line-of-sight
  • Psychology: Morale, fatigue, experience, and leadership influence how soldiers fight — and when they break
  • Scale: Every soldier is individually modeled, but you command them in units of tens or hundreds for seamless control

Free to Play

Battle Match is free to download and play. Sandbox mode is always free. Join any multiplayer match at any time.
Upgrade to WARLORD to host as many matches as you want, whenever you want — no gameplay advantage.

Game Modes

  • Sandbox: Experiment freely with units, formations, and tactics — always free
  • Matches: Start singleplayer or multiplayer battles, casual or competitive
  • Campaigns: Compete in ladders, tournaments, and conquests
  • Online Multiplayer: Challenge friends or find opponents through matchmaking
  • Team Battles: Host large multiplayer battles with several players on each side

Samurai Wars

The first Battle Match module is set in Japan's Sengoku Jidai, the age of the samurai — a modern remake of the original Samurai Wars mobile game. Take on the role of a feudal warlord commanding ashigaru, samurai, and cavalry across the battlefields of warring Japan.

Battle Match is a growing platform. Future modules will cover additional historical periods.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 (64 bit required)
  • Processor: 3.0 GHz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1GB of video RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

  • OS: Ubuntu 24.04 (64 bit required)
  • Processor: 3.6 GHz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2GB of video RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
